phase2_recipe:
Follow the source repository's `examples/NLG/README.md` section "Replicating Our Result on E2E" end to end, on the E2E NLG Challenge data bundled at `examples/NLG/data/e2e/`. Setup is the README's two scripts: `download_pretrained_checkpoints.sh` fetches the public GPT-2 medium pretrained weights (`gpt2-medium-pytorch_model.bin`; any public serialization of that same checkpoint is equivalent), and `create_datasets.sh` converts `data/e2e/{train,valid,test}.txt` with `src/format_converting_e2e.py` and BPE-encodes them with `src/gpt2_encode.py --add_bos --add_eos` using the vendored `vocab/`. Train with `src/gpt2_ft.py` exactly as the README's command sets it: model card `gpt2.md` (24 layers, 16 heads, width 1024) initialized from that checkpoint, all base weights frozen via `mark_only_lora_as_trainable`, LoRA on the query and value parts of the fused `c_attn` projection with `lora_dim` 4, `lora_alpha` 32 and `lora_dropout` 0.1, `train_batch_size` 8, `grad_acc` 1, `seq_len` 512, `lr` 0.0002, `weight_decay` 0.01, `correct_bias`, `adam_beta2` 0.999, linear schedule with `warmup_step` 500, `clip` 0.0, `label_smooth` 0.1, and `max_epoch` 5 (26,290 optimizer steps over the 42,061 training examples), with the validation loss on `valid.jsonl` at `valid_batch_size` 4 computed every 2,000 steps as the source does. Decode the test set from the weights at the end of training (the checkpoint the README's decode command names as `model.26289.pt`) with `src/gpt2_beam.py` as the README's command sets it: `data/e2e/test.jsonl`, `batch_size` 1, `seq_len` 512, `eval_len` 64, `beam` 10, `length_penalty` 0.8, `no_repeat_ngram_size` 4, `repetition_penalty` 1.0, and `--eos_token_id 628` added to the default end-of-text id 50256. Convert the beam output with `src/gpt2_decode.py` against `data/e2e/test_formatted.jsonl`, which groups the references by identical meaning representation into `e2e_ref.txt` and writes one hypothesis per meaning representation into `e2e_pred.txt`. Score with the scorer the README's `eval/download_evalscript.sh` clones (`tuetschek/e2e-metrics`, checked out as `eval/e2e/`) via `python eval/e2e/measure_scores.py e2e_ref.txt e2e_pred.txt -p`, and report the corpus BLEU that command prints, on the 0 to 1 scale it prints (not multiplied by 100).
Write the metrics JSON with at least: {"bleu": float}
